title: Takes ages to sync
body: I got this planner and immediately loved the simplicity of it. Got even the Pro version because I wanted to support the creator. But after trying to use this planner for weeks, I’m totally bummed. It takes ages to sync with my Google calendar. By ages I mean days and weeks! For example, I set up my day schedule in Google calendar yesterday evening at about 9pm. It’s 11.30am next day and my calendar is still not synced. That’s been happening all the time, days go by before the calendars actually sync. Which is ok if you always have the same schedule and same routines, but if you add something new, it becomes completely useless. Disappointed, what a waste of money.
